en: Dependent on a root-condition that is a state fixed in the wrong way, there arises a non-root-condition that is not fixed in the wrong way by way of root-condition. … (In all cases, three.
Dependent on a root-condition that is a state fixed in the right way, there arises a non-root-condition that is not fixed in the right way by way of root-condition. … (In all cases, three.

Dependent on a non-root-condition that is an undetermined state, there arises a non-non-root-condition that is not undetermined by way of root-condition. … Under root [condition], three; … pe … under non-disappearance [condition], three.
